people.name: Javan
people.line: Son of Japheth; ancestor of Greek people

translations.web: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.
translations.bsb: I am obligated both to Greeks and non-Greeks, both to the wise and the foolish.
translations.kjv: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.
translations.asv: I am debtor both to Greeks and to Barbarians, both to the wise and to the foolish.
